BasicTask
A task built from lambdas: init runs once, then run is polled each loop and returns true when the task is finished.
Binding
A named boolean condition, typically wired to a gamepad button or a robot state.
BindingManager
A registry of named Bindings (boolean conditions) and AnalogBindings (analog inputs).
BindingModule
A Module that runs an action whenever its binding fires.
ColorSensorDevice
A Device wrapping a ColorSensor.
CompoundController
A Controller that combines several sub-controllers, summing their outputs each loop.
CompoundSubsystem
A Subsystem that groups several child subsystems and fans each lifecycle call (init/start/update/stop) out to all of them.
Controller
Base type for closed-loop and feedforward controllers.
CRServoDevice
A Device wrapping a CRServo (continuous-rotation servo).
DeadlineTask
Runs its child tasks alongside a deadline task and completes when the deadline finishes, regardless of whether the other tasks have finished.
DeferredTask
A task that defers building its inner task until init() is called at runtime.
Device
A hardware wrapper that is refreshed once per loop via Device.update().
DeviceSubsystem
A Subsystem backed by a single Device.
DigitalInputDevice
A Device wrapping a DigitalChannel configured as an input (e.g.
DistanceSensorDevice
A Device wrapping a DistanceSensor.
Entry
A single telemetry line: a label paired with a Supplier whose value is fetched fresh each time the entry is displayed, grouped under a tag for selective display by TelemetryManager.
FFController
A feedforward Controller.
FollowPathTask
A task that follows a PedroPathing Path, finishing when the follower is no longer busy.
HoldPointTask
A task that commands the PedroPathing follower to hold a pose, finishing immediately after issuing the command.
IMUDevice
A Device wrapping the universal IMU.
InstantTask
A task that runs an action once in InstantTask.init() and finishes immediately.
LambdaModule
A Module whose four lifecycle phases (init/start/loop/stop) are supplied as lambdas, for quick inline behavior without declaring a dedicated module class.
ModularOpMode
Base class for OpModes assembled from reusable parts.
Module
A reusable, OpMode-shaped unit of behavior.
MotorDevice
A Device wrapping a DcMotorEx.
NullController
A no-op Controller whose NullController.update(double, double) always returns 0.
NullDevice
A no-op Device whose NullDevice.update() does nothing.
NullModule
A no-op Module whose lifecycle methods do nothing.
NullSubsystem
A Subsystem whose lifecycle methods all do nothing.
NullTask
A task that does nothing and finishes immediately; the idle placeholder held by TaskMaster.
ParallelTask
Runs all of its child tasks at once.
PIDController
A proportional-integral-derivative (PID) feedback Controller.
PositionMotorDevice
 
RaceTask
Runs all of its child tasks at once and completes as soon as any one of them finishes.
RepeatTask
Repeatedly runs a freshly built task: each time the current task finishes, a new one is built from the supplier and started immediately.
RevColorSensorV3Device
A fast Device for the REV Color Sensor V3 (Broadcom APDS-9151).
SequentialTask
Runs its child tasks one after another, advancing to the next only when the current one finishes.
ServoDevice
A Device wrapping a Servo.
SleepTask
A task that finishes after a fixed delay (in milliseconds) has elapsed since SleepTask.init().
Subsystem
A robot mechanism with a fixed lifecycle: Subsystem.init() once on OpMode init, Subsystem.start() once when the OpMode starts, Subsystem.update() every loop, and Subsystem.stop() once when it ends.
Task
Base type for all actions in the task framework.
TaskMaster
Drives a single active Task to completion, one loop at a time.
TelemetryManager
Manages a set of telemetry entries and controls which are pushed to the driver station.
TeleOpPedroModule
A simple Module that handles driving with PedroPathing.
ThreadedIMU
A Subsystem that reads the IMU on its own background thread so the main loop never blocks on it.
ToggleBinding
A Binding that flips its state on each rising edge of the underlying condition.
TouchSensorDevice
A Device wrapping a TouchSensor.
VelocityMotorDevice
 
WaitUntilTask
A task that finishes as soon as the supplied condition becomes true.
